method: Compare the exact multiset of all bundled input/output pairs against train pairs from the 82 v0.4 confirmed-mechanism training source tasks; exclude visible Kaggle test task IDs. No answers from the test or evaluation sets are used.
limitations: This confirms the exact runtime pair provenance and exclusion of visible test IDs, not that previous development never exposed other public tasks.
It does not establish a causal learning benefit or prove hidden-set exclusion.
